maya: quick check — ran speculative proxy path on l2-13b q4_0 with dynamic prefetch. seeing p50 token latency drop ~1.6x but MMLU micro exact-match down ~0.8 pts. anyone else see this tradeoff?

samir: can you paste the run config + perf numbers? esp batch=1 p50/p95 and tokens/sec

maya: sure, quick paste from harness:
```
model: l2-13b-q4_0
speculative: enabled
spec_accept_threshold: 0.55
batch: 1
warmup_prefix: 64
p50: 22ms -> 14ms
p95: 60ms -> 42ms
tokens/sec: 190 -> 290
MMLU_acc: 74.2 -> 73.4 (-0.8)
```

priya: did you warm the KV cache and keep same decoding hyperparams? speculative can amplify sampling noise if kv misses happen

maya: warmed KV with the 64-token prefix on both runs, same top-p/top-k/temperature. repeated x3 seeds, numbers hold up

lucas: try q4_1 and q8 too — quantization can interact with the acceptor's scoring. also run with `spec_accept_threshold` variants (0.5/0.6)

maya: will run q4_1 and q8 tomorrow. quick note: ops-bot reported one fallback event during the run — looks like a mismatch triggered fallback to baseline

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary autoscaler triggered fallback on node infra-134 at 03:22 UTC — see /var/log/decode/fallback.log (single event)

samir: for eval methodology: lock RNG, run N seeds, report mean+std for quality metrics, and log per-example whether speculative accepted or fell back. include answer-level EM and embedding-similarity for soft matches

maya: agreed. I'll add deterministic seeds, per-example accept flag, BLEU/EM, and also sweep `spec_accept_threshold` 0.45/0.5/0.55/0.6. will also test q4_1 and q8

priya: :thumbsup: thanks — this is a great quickcheck. keep this thread for results and small repro artifacts

maya: adding repro script in harness tomorrow, will ping when done
